edges: Mohamed ElBaradei praised Iran's transparency and indispensable cooperation.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Iran is unlikely to have a nuclear weapon by 2010 or earlier.
Iran is projected to potentially develop a bomb within a specified timeframe.
The CIA found no conclusive evidence of a secret Iranian nuclear weapons program.
Iran is opting out of its moratorium in the absence of answers to serious questions from the IAEA.
Iran has declared civilian operations to the International Atomic Energy Agency.
